changes.name: Drugs of Fogport
changes.entry:
Fogport’s narcotics include chemicals, bottled emotions, parasites, powdered impossibilities and living creatures that alter probability. Every miracle carries an answering consequence. Dealers call it the Second Condition. Addicts call it the price.

Dream-Sleed

A silvery resin producing at least twenty-four hours of vivid, overwhelmingly positive dreams. Each dose continues the same dream-life and doubles its subjective duration.

Second Condition: The sleeper becomes lighter than air and must be tethered and given nutrient water. Eventually the Sleed Life becomes longer and more convincing than waking life.

Birza

Tiny living birds swallowed whole make the user brave, euphoric and extraordinarily lucky.

Second Condition: Twice as many hours of equally powerful misfortune follow, while the user remains unable to recognize that their luck has changed.

Borrowed Sunday

An amber cordial creates certainty that everything will be all right.

Second Condition: The following day is erased from memory as it occurs, including every deed, promise, confession and signature.

Knucklebloom

Black seeds beneath the hand grant immense strength and eliminate pain.

Second Condition: White flowers emerge from the knuckles; the user cannot unclench their fists without breaking fingers until they wither.

Mother’s Voice

Blue vapor recreates the comforting voice of whoever made the user feel safest as a child.

Second Condition: With continued use, the voice begins asking for favors.

Red Mathematics

Crimson crystals reveal bodies, distances and trajectories as luminous equations.

Second Condition: Living beings remain mere quantities for hours afterward, making killing feel like correcting a sum.

Gallowsmilk

Gray milk eliminates fear of death and grants perfect calm.

Second Condition: The instinct for self-preservation also vanishes; even breathing must be consciously remembered.

Little Kings

Golden beetles in the ears make every word sound authoritative, witty and wise.

Second Condition: Their constant flattery eventually convinces the host that they are Fogport’s unlawfully denied monarch.

Hushbone

A deep-sea cartilage lozenge silences pain, anxiety and intrusive thought.

Second Condition: It also silences voice, footsteps and heartbeat; habitual users may cease making any sound.

Saint’s Mistake

Oil on the eyelids reveals the best possible version of everyone.

Second Condition: Afterward, the user sees only the worst possible version of themselves.

Quickwinter

Silver powder makes the world seem almost still and grants phenomenal reflexes.

Second Condition: The body ages at the speed perceived; five minutes may cost several months of life.

Crowglass

A black sweet lets the user see through nearby birds.

Second Condition: The birds can also see through the user. Some follow them; others report what they witness.

Warm Ghost

A translucent worm creates the sensation of an absent or dead loved one’s embrace.

Second Condition: The embrace tightens with every use, progressing from bruises to broken ribs and strangulation.

Scrivener’s Mercy

Injected green ink grants perfect recall until sunrise.

Second Condition: An older memory appears as readable writing across the user’s skin before fading forever.

Brass Lion

A metallic pellet swallowed with lamp oil grants courage, endurance and a booming voice.

Second Condition: The user becomes physically incapable of stepping backward or retreating.

Secondhand

Paired wax tablets let two users share physical sensations across any distance.

Second Condition: The bond lasts until both tablets leave the body or one participant dies.

Drownlight

Phosphorescent drops grant perfect sight through darkness, fog, smoke and murky water.

Second Condition: Daylight becomes completely opaque, like a solid white wall.

The Applause

Rose powder creates an invisible audience that cheers risk.

Second Condition: It boos caution and demands ever greater danger.

Yesterday’s Teeth

Tiny teeth dissolved in tea restore the drinker’s health and appearance from ten years earlier.

Second Condition: Someone within ten paces instantly ages the same amount, possibly someone the drinker loves.

Morrowmoths

Powdered wings reveal several possible immediate futures.

Second Condition: One vision is always false but overwhelmingly convincing; repeated use destroys the distinction between prophecy, memory and imagination.

Dead Man’s Holiday

A black wafer removes the need for food, water, warmth, sleep and breath for twelve hours; the user registers as dead.

Second Condition: At the end, breathing, swallowing, blinking and heartbeat must restart. Some restart incorrectly; some never restart. Every dose carries a genuine risk of death.

Velvet Teeth

Purple gum-paste makes every sensation exquisitely pleasurable, including injury.

Second Condition: Danger becomes indistinguishable from pleasure, and ordinary sensation afterward becomes intolerably dull.
